name: aidb-studio
description: AI-native cross-platform database studio with an autonomous agent

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n bridge,ui "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n bridge,ui,electron "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web" "npm --workspace apps/desktop run dev:electron"
scripts.test: npm --workspace @aidb/core run test && npm --workspace @aidb/client run test && npm --workspace @aidb/gateway run test && npm --workspace @aidb/desktop run test && npm --workspace @aidb/mobile run test && npm --workspace @aidb-studio/aidb-studio run test && node --test "apps/desktop/electron/*.test.cjs"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm --workspace apps/gateway run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run build && npm run build:mobile
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:core && npm --workspace apps/desktop run package
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:controls && npm run verify:i18n && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.verify:ci: npm run test:workflows && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:controls && npm run verify:i18n && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
